nodes.label: Virtual Contest Replay Page
nodes.rationale: Practice-mode replay of a past contest with the original time limit; explicitly causes no rating change and submissions appear on the leaderboard with a VIRTUAL tag, letting users experience contest pressure without rating risk. Posts answers (q_<pk> fields, MCQ radio 1-4 or textarea) to the same contest_submit endpoint as live contests.

nodes.label: Virtual Contest Countdown Auto-Submit Timer
nodes.rationale: Client-side setTimeout loop seeded from contest.duration_minutes; force-submits the form when time expires so virtual attempts respect the original duration.
